pages.text: Mekanism is the primary T3–T4 tech mod. Ore processing, gas handling, advanced machines, and the road to MekaSuit.

$(bold)T3 access:$(/bold) Basic Mekanism machines (Enrichment Chamber, Purification Chamber, Crusher, Chemical Injection) unlock at T3. Osmium is the T3 base material.$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$(/bold) Full Mekanism processing chain yields up to 5 ingots per ore. Building this chain is a major T3 engineering project.

$(bold)T4 upgrade:$(/bold) MekaTool, Mekasuit, QIO Network, Fusion Reactor, and Antimatter production are T4 content. Planning your T3 infrastructure for T4 upgrades is a good use of T3 time.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$(/bold) Efficient Engineering boosts all Mekanism factory speeds. T3 Artificer is the fastest path to T4.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Mekanism is documented via JEI and the $(bold)Mekanism wiki$(/bold) (mekanismmod.com). In-game, hover any machine in JEI and press $(bold)R$(/bold) for recipes, $(bold)U$(/bold) for uses.
